title: Pool Bound
statement: Implement `solve(cap, jobs)`. Return the worker count to use: the minimum of `cap` and `jobs`, and 0 if either is 0 or negative.
constraints: Do not start more workers than jobs
hints: Otherwise return the smaller of cap and jobs.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A pool larger than the job count wastes threads.

editorial: A pool larger than the job count wastes threads. A pool larger than the cap stampedes a shared resource. The bound is the minimum of the two, after rejecting non-positive configuration that cannot mean a real pool.
